## Dole plc to Participate in the Stephens Annual Investment Conference


Nov 04 2026


Download (opens in new window)


DUBLIN--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Dole plc (NYSE: DOLE) today announced that management will participate in the Stephens Annual Investment Conference to be held November 17-19, 2026, in Nashville, Tennessee.


Management will participate in a fireside chat at 8:45 a.m. CT on November 19 and will conduct one-on-one meetings with investors attending the conference on that day. To schedule a meeting with management, please contact your Stephens representative.


A live webcast of the fireside chat and a replay following the event will be available through the Events & Presentations section of Dole’s Investor Relations website:[www.doleplc.com/investor-relations/events-and-presentations](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.doleplc.com%2Finvestor-relations%2Fevents-and-presentations&esheet=54634685&newsitemid=20261104194375&lan=en-US&anchor=www.doleplc.com%2Finvestor-relations%2Fevents-and-presentations&index=1&md5=6194875e2a9b911340cf93a52cdb2967) .


**About Dole plc:**


A global leader in fresh produce,[Dole plc](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.doleplc.com&esheet=54634685&newsitemid=20261104194375&lan=en-US&anchor=Dole+plc&index=2&md5=cf7a54d08c378d53123843cf42748bb3) grows, markets, and distributes an extensive variety of fresh fruits and vegetables sourced locally and from around the world. Dedicated to exceeding our customers' requirements in more than 85 countries, our goal is to make the world a healthier and more sustainable place.
